title: Bridgford Foods Corporation Declares Cash Dividend
summary: ANAHEIM, Calif., Nov. 13, 2012 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bridgford Foods Corporation (Nasdaq:BRID) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a...
body_text: ANAHEIM, Calif., Nov. 13, 2012 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bridgford Foods Corporation (Nasdaq:BRID) today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a one-time cash dividend of $0.05 per share of common stock for shareholders of record on November 27, 2012, payable on December 24, 2012, based on operations to date for fiscal year 2012. Bridgford Foods Corporation is currently preparing its 2012 annual report and will distribute copies to shareholders when completed. Bridgford Foods Corporation is a producer of frozen dough, microwaveable sandwiches, dry sausage, processed meats and other convenience food products. The Bridgford Foods Corporation logo is available at http://www.globenewswire.com/newsroom/prs/?pkgid=6840

title: Voltmeter Case Sports Safety Features
summary: Advanced Energy offers a new Cordura Nylon Carrying Case to improve worker safety.
body_text: Home / About AE / News & Events / Blog / Voltmeter Case Sports Safety Features Voltmeter Case Sports Safety Features Posted November 06, 2012 by Advanced Energy Editor Contains no metal, making it safer around energized conductors Advanced Energy offers a new Cordura Nylon Carrying Case to improve worker safety. The model 1204A case will fit any of the three Safety Volt Meters, models 110A, 122, and 125 (note, all SVM models are now discontinued). The sturdy case, has several features that help users make safer measurements: No metal parts, making it safe for use around energized conductors. Buckled shoulder strap for carrying and clipping over a pipe or pole, allowing a user to use both hands for making a measurement. Magnet in the cover flap to allow a user to attach it to any steel surface.
